title: Mini Pineapple Honey Infused Hair Perfume
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fresh Scent✓ Good for: Dryness✓ High Shine Finish
Key Notes: Coconut, Pineapple, Vanilla

Fragrance Description: An irresistible hair perfume, infused with Mirsalehi Honey to add shine and instantly scent hair with notes of sweet pineapple, creamy coconut, and vanilla.

About the Fragrance: Blending juicy pineapple with creamy coconut and sweet vanilla, this sunkissed scent captures the feeling of sipping a piña colada while on a tropical island escape—bright, smooth, and effortlessly refreshing.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a longer-lasting, stronger scent.
-After applying, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.
-If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent handwashing, as this tends to rinse off the scent.
-Replace fragrance after 12 months. Expired perfumes more than a year old lose the integrity of the original scent.

Eau de Toilette or Eau de Parfum?:
The difference lies in the volume of perfume oil. While EDT contains five to nine percent, EDP contains more, usually eight to 14 percent. EDPs, therefore, last longer and smell more intense.
Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Aqua (Water, Eau), Parfum (Fragrance), PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Sodium Benzotriazolyl Butylphenol Sulfonate, Tris(Tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) Citrate, Benzaldehyde**, Benzyl Alcohol**, Benzyl Salicylate**, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil*, Coumarin**, Hexadecanolactone**, Isoeugenyl Acetate**, Limonene**, Linalool**, Pinene**, Pogostemon Cablin Oil**, Rose Ketones**, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes**, Vanillin**, CI 19140, CI 14700.

*Honey sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.
**Allergens.
